summary: Chunghwa Telecom filed a Form 6-K reporting three board actions from its November 6, 2026 meeting: approval of unaudited consolidated results for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 (revenue NT$188.9bn, net operating income NT$41.7bn, net profit NT$34.8bn, EPS NT$4.25); approval of an unsecured corporate bond program of up to NT$20bn; and appointment of a new Chief Audit Executive. The bonds, issued at 100% of par with maturities up to 10 years, fund capex, debt repayment and working capital. Routine financial disclosure, financing and internal appointment—no special-situation event; no arbitrage angle.
